customer_id.description: The customer: a contact marked as a customer.

date.description: The invoice's date: its tax point.

due_date.description: When it falls due; left out, the customer's payment terms, else the organisation's (FR-ORG-04). A credit note has none.

fx_rate.description: For an invoice in another currency: base currency per one unit. Left out, the invoice takes the cascade's rate for its date (ENG-40).

invoice_id.description: A credit note only: the issued invoice of the same customer and currency it credits, in full or in part; left out, a standalone credit note. A linked credit note adjusts GST at the rates in force on that invoice's date, and credits at most its total.

kind.description: invoice, the default, or credit_note: a credit note to the customer, entered as an invoice is and issued as its reverse (FR-AR-04). Fixed once saved.

reference.description: The customer's reference for it, such as their purchase order number.
